title: C-O5 fix round 3: git identity in the container, read-only orchestrator install with protected container paths, complete executor.env template, enforced installer checksums, ~/.config ownership (from review T-0181)
spec:
Fix round for T-0178 (branch task/T-0178 at 156e120). Work in this task's worktree, cut from task/T-0178. Review T-0181 (opus) requested changes; items come from it. Scope: Dockerfile, docker-compose.executor.yml, docs/executor-host.md, .orchestrator/protected-paths.txt. Build natively only (no --platform emulation).

1 HIGH git identity: goals.py runs `git commit` in every cloned target and the container has no identity. Dockerfile: `RUN git config --system user.name "orchestrator-executor" && git config --system user.email "orchestrator@localhost"` as a baked default, and the runbook's executor.env template documents GIT_AUTHOR_NAME / GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL / GIT_COMMITTER_NAME / GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL as optional overrides (git honours them over config). Verify after the native build: `docker run --rm orch-exec:test sh -c 'cd /tmp && git init -q t && cd t && git commit -q --allow-empty -m x && git log -1 --format=%an'` prints the name.

2 MED read-only install: `COPY . /opt/orchestrator` owned by root:root (no --chown), then `uv sync --frozen` as root and `chown -R orch:orch /opt/orchestrator/.venv` so orch can run but not rewrite the orchestrator code or hooks; WORKDIR and entrypoint unchanged. protected-paths.txt: add the container paths `/opt/orchestrator/.claude`, `/opt/orchestrator/orchestrator`, `/opt/orchestrator/.orchestrator/protected-paths.txt` (same format as the existing lines). Verify: `docker run --rm orch-exec:test sh -c 'touch /opt/orchestrator/orchestrator/x' ` fails with permission denied while `uv run orchestrator --help` (or `python -c "import orchestrator"`) works.

3 MED runbook executor.env template: add GH_WRITE_TOKEN (used by pool.toml [secrets.planner]) with a one-line note on what it is for (the Planner opens the goal PR) and how to mint a fine-grained token limited to the target repos; keep every value as `<paste here>`.

4 LOW Dockerfile installer integrity: add `ARG UV_INSTALL_SHA256=""` and `ARG CLAUDE_INSTALL_SHA256=""`; when non-empty, `echo "<sha>  <file>" | sha256sum -c` before executing the downloaded script, else only log the hash (comment says so). Move `COPY . /opt/orchestrator` below all installer RUN layers so source edits do not re-download installers.

5 LOW Dockerfile: `RUN install -d -o orch -g orch /home/orch/.config /home/orch/.local /home/orch/.cache` before the mounts so the gh bind-mount parent is orch-owned.

Re-run: native `docker build` (image size, four versions, arch), the two verification commands above, `docker compose -f docker-compose.executor.yml config` with dummy executor.env/.env/ORCH_CREDS/ORCH_NET (no ports, six mounts), objective secret grep clean, `uv run python -m unittest discover -q tests` green. Commit on the task branch (only the four scoped files). Finish with: summary, files changed, build evidence, failures-only test output.
acceptance: Baked git identity present and overridable via GIT_* env; the empty-commit check inside the image prints the author name
/opt/orchestrator is root-owned and not writable by orch while the venv works; protected-paths.txt lists the three container paths
executor.env template includes GH_WRITE_TOKEN with its purpose; all values remain placeholders
Installer scripts verified by sha256sum -c when the ARGs are set, logged otherwise; COPY sits below the installer layers

Native docker build succeeds with four versions; compose config validates with six mounts and no ports; secret grep clean; unit tests green; committed on the task branch; only the four scoped files change

result.summary:
Committed cleanly on `task/T-0183`.

## Summary

Fixed all 5 review items from T-0181 in `Dockerfile`, `docs/executor-host.md`, and `.orchestrator/protected-paths.txt` (`docker-compose.executor.yml` needed no content changes, only re-verification).

1. **Git identity**: baked `git config --system user.name/email` as root; runbook documents `GIT_AUTHOR_NAME/EMAIL`, `GIT_COMMITTER_NAME/EMAIL` as optional overrides.
2. **Read-only install**: `COPY` (no `--chown`) + `uv sync --frozen` run as root, then only `.venv` is `chown`'d to `orch`; added the three container paths to `protected-paths.txt`.
3. **GH_WRITE_TOKEN**: added to the executor.env template with purpose (Planner opens the goal PR) and fine-grained-token guidance.
4. **Installer integrity**: added `UV_INSTALL_SHA256`/`CLAUDE_INSTALL_SHA256` ARGs, verified via `sha256sum -c` when set else logged; moved `COPY` below all installer layers.
5. **Pre-created** `/home/orch/.config`, `.local`, `.cache` before any mounts.

One fix beyond the spec's literal wording was needed to make it actually work: running `uv sync --frozen` as root inside `/home/orch/.cache/uv` (via `$HOME`) left root-owned cache files that blocked `orch` from writing at runtime, breaking `uv run orchestrator --help`. Fixed by pointing that build step at `UV_CACHE_DIR=/root/.cache/uv` instead.

**Build evidence** (native arm64, no emulation): image built successfully, 1.61GB, arch `arm64`; four tool versions confirmed (`uv 0.12.16`, `Claude Code 2.1.276`, `codex-cli 0.155.0`, `Python 3.12.3`); git-identity check printed `orchestrator-executor orchestrator@localhost`; write to `/opt/orchestrator/orchestrator/x` failed with permission denied while `uv run orchestrator --help` succeeded; `docker compose config` validated with six mounts and no ports; secret grep on the diff was clean.

**Test output**: `.claude/hooks/tests-green.sh` and `uv run python -m unittest discover -q tests` — 191 tests, all passed, no failures.

Committed as `88c0798` on `task/T-0183`. Nothing left outstanding on this spec.
